get.summary:

pagination. Supports multiple query patterns based on provided filters for
optimal performance.

parameters.name: sell_denom

parameters.name: bid_denom

get.summary:
*
AuctionsByPairPriceRange queries auctions for a pair whose effective price
falls within bounds. Filters auctions by sell/bid denom pair; price
filtering is placeholder. Results ordered by auction ID ascending.

parameters.name: sell_denom
parameters.description: Sell denom of the pair (denomination being auctioned).

parameters.name: bid_denom
parameters.description: Bid denom of the pair (denomination used for bidding).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description:
Minimum price threshold as bid-per-sell cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description:
Maximum price threshold as bid-per-sell cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

get.summary:
*
AuctionsBySeller queries auctions created by a specific seller address.

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description:
Seller address to filter auctions by; returns auctions created by this
address

get.summary:
*
Auction queries a single auction by ID.

parameters.name: auction_id
parameters.description: ID of the auction to retrieve

get.summary:
*
Metrics computes comprehensive module metrics including escrow balances and
trade statistics.

*
Offers provides unified offer listing with optional denom filters and
pagination. Supports multiple query patterns based on provided filters for
optimal performance. Canonicalizes pairs for consistent indexing and
ordering.

parameters.name: have_denom
parameters.description: Optional have denom filter; restricts to offers selling this denomination.

parameters.name: want_denom
parameters.description: Optional want denom filter; restricts to offers buying this denomination.

get.summary:
*
OffersBest returns up to limit best-priced offers for a pair (convenience
endpoint). Returns top offers for a pair sorted by price (want-per-have,
ascending = best for takers). Canonicalizes pair for indexing; applies
limit (defaulting to 10) via pagination.

parameters.name: have_denom
parameters.description: Have denom of the pair (denomination being sold).

parameters.name: want_denom
parameters.description: Want denom of the pair (denomination being bought).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of best-priced offers to return (default: 10).

get.summary:
*
OffersByDenom queries offers that reference a specific denom either as have
or want side. Uses role filter to restrict to "have" side, "want" side, or
both (when empty). Leverages appropriate indices when role is specified for
efficiency.

parameters.name: denom
parameters.description: Denomination to search for in offers.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description:
Role filter: "have" restricts to have-denom, "want" restricts to
want-denom, empty string includes both sides.

get.summary:
*
OffersByPairPriceRange queries offers for a pair whose price lies within
optional bounds. Filters offers by denom pair and price range
(want-per-have ratio). Canonicalizes pair for consistent indexing; bounds
are inclusive and optional. Uses OffersByPairPrice index for efficient
ordered scanning.

parameters.name: have_denom
parameters.description: Have denom of the pair (denomination being sold).

parameters.name: want_denom
parameters.description: Want denom of the pair (denomination being bought).

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description:
Minimum price threshold as want-per-have cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description:
Maximum price threshold as want-per-have cosmos.Dec string (optional,
inclusive).

get.summary:
*
OffersByOwner queries offers by owner address with optional status filter.
Uses indexed queries for owner+status combinations for optimal performance.
Falls back to filtered scans when only partial filters are provided.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Owner address to filter offers by; must be a valid bech32 address

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Optional status filter; valid values are "open", "closed", "cancelled"
If empty, returns offers with any status. Enables indexed queries when
combined with owner.

get.summary:
*
Offer queries a single offer by ID.

parameters.name: offer_id
parameters.description: ID of the offer to retrieve

get.summary:
*
Params queries the current whaleswap module parameters.

*
Pools lists all AMM pools with pagination.

*
PoolsByDenom queries all pools that include a specific denom on either
side. Returns pools where the specified denom appears in either coin
position. Results ordered by pool ID ascending.

parameters.name: denom
parameters.description:
Denomination to search for; returns pools where this denom appears on

get.summary:
*
PoolsByPair queries all pools matching a denom pair with pagination.
Denom order in the request is irrelevant as pairs are canonicalized
internally. Results ordered by pool ID for consistent pagination.

parameters.name: base_denom
parameters.description:
Base denom of the pair (price is quote/base); order with quote_denom is
irrelevant.

parameters.name: quote_denom
parameters.description: Quote denom of the pair; combined with base_denom forms the trading pair.

get.summary:
*
PoolsByPairPriceRange queries pools for a pair whose instantaneous price
falls within optional bounds. Filters pools by denom pair and price range
(quote/base ratio from reserves). Bounds are inclusive and optional;
omitting both returns all matching pairs. Results ordered by pool ID
ascending.

parameters.name: base_denom
parameters.description:
Base denom of the pair (price is quote/base); order with quote_denom is
irrelevant.

parameters.name: quote_denom
parameters.description: Quote denom of the pair; combined with base_denom forms the trading pair.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price threshold as cosmos.Dec string (optional, inclusive).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price threshold as cosmos.Dec string (optional, inclusive).

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

reverse.description:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending
order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

coins.description:
coins holds exactly two coins in canonical denom order (denom[0] <
denom[1]). All math derives price as P = coins[1].amount / coins[0].amount.

fee_pct.description:
Deprecated: fee_pct is the legacy pool swap fee percentage (cosmos.Dec
string in [0,1)). Use fee_rate field 25 instead. Migration logic should
read this and convert to fee_rate format (two DecCoins, one per reserve
denom in canonical order).

min_price.description:
Deprecated legacy price band fields retained for decoding old genesis

fees_earned.title: cumulative swap fees retained by the pool (accrue to LPs)

interest_rate.description:
═════ LEVERAGE FIELDS ═════
Annual interest rates per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order).
Each amount is a decimal string representing APR (per-year accrual).

min_collateral_ratio.description:
═════ PER-POOL LEVERAGE RISK PARAMETERS (per-denom) ═════
Minimum collateral ratio required at position open per reserve denom
(exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a decimal string (> 1).

max_leverage_ratio.description:
Maximum leverage ratio allowed (collateral + borrowed) / collateral per
reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a decimal
string (> 1).

liquidation_threshold.description:
Collateral ratio threshold below which position is liquidatable per reserve
denom (exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a decimal string
(> 1).

max_borrow_percent.description:
Maximum borrow capacity per reserve denom as DecCoins (exactly two,
canonical order). Each amount is a decimal in [0,1).

bound_percent.description:
Directional price-impact bounds keyed by the sold denom.
Each amount must satisfy 0 < x <= 1; x == 1 disables the bound (unbounded).
Missing entries default to 1 for both pool denoms. Stored in canonical pool
order (coins[0], coins[1]). During swaps, selling denom D enforces that the
post-trade price of D quoted in the opposite denom may drop by at most
x fraction (B = 1/(1-x) multiplier). Values outside (0,1] are rejected at
validation time.

fee_rate.description:
fee_rate is the per-denom pool swap fee rate (amount in [0,1)), exactly two
entries in canonical pool order matching coins[0].denom and coins[1].denom.
Fee is applied to the OUTPUT denom of each swap leg: for exact-in, the
computed gross output is reduced by fee; for exact-out, the required gross
output is inflated so net (after fee) meets the target. Fees accrue to
fees_earned in the output denom.
Replaces deprecated fee_pct field 5.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.Pool.description:
Pool describes AMM pool state.

Notes:
- coin_a.denom < coin_b.denom lexicographically (canonical order)
- fee_rate is a per-denom decimal rate in [0,1) as DecCoins
- coin_a.amount/coin_b.amount are sdk.Int strings.
- The instantaneous price used by price-based queries is derived from
  reserves as P = coin_b / coin_a, consistent with the notes above.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.SettlementMod.description:
SettlementMode selects how offers fund the "have" side:
- ESCROW: Escrow base have in the module at offer creation.
- LIQUID: Do not escrow base; lock PFAND and settle from maker balance at
take.

swap_in.description:
Exactly one of swap_in (exact-in) or swap_out (exact-out) must be set.
Use message-level min_output for rate constraints across legs.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to take from; offer must exist and be in open status.

take_units.description:
Units to take (sdk.Int string). If empty, take full remaining. Must be
positive and ≤ remaining.

offer_id.title:
═════ DEPRECATED FIELDS (fields 2-10) - for migration compatibility ═════
These fields are kept for backwards compatibility. Migration logic should
read these and populate the new fields (20+) below.
Deprecated: use operations field 23 and trader field 20 instead

pool_id.title: Deprecated: use operations field 23 to infer pool swaps

auction_id.title: Deprecated: use operations field 23 to infer auction redemptions

Trader address (was taker in old schema, field 3)

operations.description:
Operations executed in this trade (from tx.proto TradeOperation).
Each operation records what was sent/received for that specific step.
Replaces offer_id/pool_id/auction_id fields (2, 8, 9) from old schema.

total_sent.title: Aggregated totals across all operations (was single sent field 6)

total_received.title: Aggregated totals across all operations (was single received field 7)

note.title: Optional note (was field 10 in old schema)

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.Trade.description:
Trade captures a batch of operations executed atomically in a single message.
Operations are stored in execution order, preserving the exact sequence from
the original message (MsgMakeTrade, MsgPoolSwap, MsgTakeOffer,
MsgRedeemAuction).

escrowed_pool_coins.title: Sum of reserves across all AMM pools

escrowed_offer_coins.title: Sum of remaining_have over all open escrow-mode offers

escrowed_pfand.title: Sum of pfand_locked over all open liquid-mode offers

escrowed_auction_coins.title: Sum of auction sell escrows over all open auctions

fees_earned.title: Sum of fees_earned across all pools (accounted inside pool reserves)

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.TradeMetrics.description:
TradeMetrics reports the expected whaleswap module balances broken down by
subsystem, and summary counters useful for monitoring and invariants.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.TradeOperatio.description:
TradeOperation allows mixing pool swap legs, orderbook takes, and auction
redemptions. When stored in Trade.operations, sent/received fields are
populated with execution results. When used in MsgMakeTrade.operations,
sent/received are empty (populated during execution).
